stories.summary: Mahdi Tounsi appeared to have suffered maltreatment at hearing where he was not allowed to hear prosecution case against him Palestinian student Mahdi Tounsi appeared in a closed-door court hearing in Jerusalem, as academics and activists warned that Israel’s attempt to jail him without trial marked a serious escalation in attacks on Palestinian rights.
